faq.q: What machine number is a buzz cut?
faq.a: Usually #2 (6 mm). Ask for #1 if you want it shorter, or #3 for a softer look.

faq.q: Is a buzz cut good for hot weather?
faq.a: Yes. With so little hair, your head stays cooler and dries in minutes.

faq.q: Will a buzz cut show scars or bumps on my head?
faq.a: At #1 or #2 they can show. Choose #3 or #4 for more cover.

faq.q: How fast does a buzz cut grow out?
faq.a: Hair grows about 1.25 cm a month, so a #2 buzz looks like a short crew cut after about a month.

faq.a: The hair is cut in two blocks: short sides underneath, and longer top hair that falls over them.

faq.q: How do I style a two-block?

faq.q: Does a side fringe cover a big forehead?
faq.a: Yes. It sweeps across and hides part of the forehead.

faq.q: How do I keep the fringe in place?
faq.a: Blow dry it to the side, then add a little light wax.

faq.q: Is a side fringe good for curly hair?
faq.a: No. Curls won't lie flat across the forehead.

barberSteps: Ask: sweep to left or right?
Blow dry fringe to that side.

name: Wolf Cut
shortLine: Shaggy, layered cut with volume on top and length at the back.
description: Shaggy, layered cut with volume on top and longer hair at the back. Wild and trendy.
pickIf: you want a bold, messy fashion look and have some natural wave.
skipIf: you have a round face or thin hair, or a strict office.
daily: 2 min: a little salt spray or light wax, then ruffle with your fingers.
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · Straight or wavy hair

faq.q: What is the difference between a wolf cut and a mullet?
faq.a: A wolf cut is layered and shaggy all over. A mullet is short at the front and sides, and long only at the back.

faq.q: Does a wolf cut work with straight hair?
faq.a: Yes, but it looks best with some wave. Salt spray adds texture.

faq.q: How long does hair need to be for a wolf cut?
faq.a: At least to the bottom of the ears at the back.

faq.q: Is a wolf cut OK for office?
faq.a: Not in strict offices. It suits college and creative jobs.

barberSteps: Back: keep length, to the collar.
Ends: choppy. Razor or point cut.

name: Man Bun
shortLine: Long hair tied up in a bun at the back of the head.
description: Long hair pulled back and tied in a bun. Relaxed, and it keeps hair off your face.
pickIf: your hair already reaches past your chin and you want to keep it long.
skipIf: your hair is shorter than your chin, or thin, or you have a long or heart-shaped face.
daily: 2 min: brush back and tie with a soft hair tie.
suitsText: Oval, square and round face · Straight or wavy hair

faq.q: How long does hair need to be for a man bun?
faq.a: Long enough to reach past your chin, so it can be tied back.

faq.q: Can tying my hair every day damage it?
faq.a: Pulling it very tight every day can damage the roots over time. Keep the bun loose and use a soft hair tie.

faq.q: Can I get short sides with a man bun?
faq.a: Yes. Ask for machine #2 on the sides, with the top kept long.

faq.q: How often should I trim a man bun?
faq.a: Every 8 weeks, to remove split ends.

barberSteps: Trim ends only: 1 finger or less.
Ask: short sides too? If yes: machine #2.
Comb back. Tie a bun to check.

name: Head Shave
shortLine: Whole head shaved smooth with a razor.
description: The whole head shaved smooth with a razor. Fresh and bold, and also chosen for rituals.
pickIf: you want the cleanest look, have hair loss, or need it for a ritual.
skipIf: you have a sensitive scalp.
daily: 1 min: moisturiser, and sun cream outdoors.
weekly: Shave at home 2–3 times to stay smooth.
nextVisit: any time, for a smooth barber shave
suitsText: Oval and square face · All hair types · Good for thin hair and hair loss

faq.q: How often do I need to shave my head?
faq.a: Every 2–3 days to keep it smooth.

faq.q: How do I avoid razor bumps on my head?
faq.a: Shave with the hair growth, use a new blade, and moisturise afterwards.

faq.q: Do I need sun cream on a shaved head?
faq.a: Yes, when you're outdoors. A bare scalp burns easily.

faq.q: Can I keep a tupi (small tuft) for a ritual?
faq.a: Yes. Tell the barber before they start.

barberSteps: Ask: keep a small tuft (tupi) at the back?
Ask: sensitive skin or cuts on the scalp?
New blade. Shave with hair growth.

name: Crop Fade
shortLine: Short, rough top pushed forward, with faded sides.
description: A French crop with skin-faded sides: a rough top pushed forward into a short fringe.
pickIf: you want one of the most popular modern cuts with almost no styling.
skipIf: you have a round face.
daily: 1 min: a little dry wax (clay) through the top.
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · All hair types · Thin hair OK

faq.q: What is the difference between a French crop and a crop fade?
faq.a: The top is the same, but on a crop fade the sides go down to skin.

faq.q: Is a crop fade good for thin hair?
faq.a: Yes. The fringe covers the front, and short sides make the top look fuller.

faq.q: What product works best?
faq.a: Dry wax (clay), for a matte, slightly messy look.

faq.q: How often should I re-cut a crop fade?
faq.a: Every 2–3 weeks.

name: Burst Fade
shortLine: Fade that curves around the ear in a half circle.
description: A fade that curves around the ear in a half circle, with a longer back.
pickIf: you want a bold, different fade, often with curls or a mohawk.
skipIf: you have a long face or a strict office.
daily: 3 min: style the top with wax or curl cream.
suitsText: Oval, square, round and heart face · All hair types · Thin hair OK

faq.q: What is a burst fade?
faq.a: A fade that curves around the ear in a half circle, leaving the back longer.

faq.q: Does a burst fade work with curly hair?
faq.a: Yes. It's often paired with curls or a mohawk.

faq.q: Is a burst fade OK for office?
faq.a: Usually not. It's a bold, fashion fade.

faq.q: How often does a burst fade need a touch-up?
faq.a: Every 2 weeks.

barberSteps: Fade shape: half circle around the ear.
Clean the edges around the ear.

name: Mohawk
shortLine: Strip of hair standing up in the middle. Sides very short.
description: A strip of hair standing up from front to back, with very short sides.
pickIf: you want the boldest look in the shop.
skipIf: you have a long face or thin hair, or school or office rules.
daily: 5 min: strong gel or wax, push the strip straight up.
suitsText: Oval, square and round face · All hair types

faq.q: What is the difference between a mohawk and a faux hawk?
faq.a: A mohawk takes the sides very short or bare. A faux hawk keeps them short but not shaved.

faq.q: How wide should the strip be?
faq.a: About 2 fingers, but you can ask for wider.

faq.q: How do I make my mohawk stand up?
faq.a: Blow dry it upward, then use strong gel or wax.

faq.q: Can I wear a mohawk down?
faq.a: Yes. Without product, the strip falls to one side.

barberSteps: Strip width: 2 fingers, front to back.
Blend the strip edges a little.

name: Modern Mullet
shortLine: Short front and sides, longer hair at the back.
description: Short front and sides, with longer hair at the back of the neck. Softer than the old-style mullet.
pickIf: you want a fun fashion look.
skipIf: you have a round face or thin hair, or a strict office.
daily: 2 min: a little light wax, messy on top.
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · Straight or wavy hair

faq.q: What is the difference between a mullet and a wolf cut?
faq.a: A mullet is short at the front and sides and long only at the back. A wolf cut is layered all over.

faq.q: How long does the back need to be?
faq.a: At least 4–5 fingers.

faq.q: Can I get a mullet with a fade?
faq.a: Yes. Many modern mullets have faded sides.

faq.q: Is a mullet OK for office?
faq.a: Not in strict offices.

barberSteps: Neck: clean the edges. Keep the length.

name: Mushroom Cut
shortLine: Rounded fringe all around the head, like a mushroom cap.
description: Korean-style rounded top that falls evenly all around, with a full fringe.
pickIf: you want a soft, neat, young look.
skipIf: you have a round face, curly hair or thin hair.
daily: 3 min: blow dry down and round, a little light spray.
suitsText: Oval, long and heart face · Straight hair

faq.q: Is a mushroom cut the same as a bowl cut?
faq.a: It's a modern, softer version, with soft edges and short sides underneath.

faq.q: Does a mushroom cut work with curly hair?
faq.a: No. It needs straight hair that falls evenly.

faq.q: How do I style a mushroom cut?
faq.a: Blow dry the hair down and slightly round, then add a little light spray.

faq.q: Does a mushroom cut suit a round face?
faq.a: Not really. The rounded shape adds width.

barberSteps: Cut a rounded line all around.

name: Comma Hair
shortLine: Korean fringe curled inward like a comma.
description: Korean fringe parted to one side and curled inward like a comma.
pickIf: you want a popular Korean style and don't mind morning styling.
skipIf: you have a round face, curly hair or thin hair, or no time in the morning.
daily: 5 min: blow dry the fringe inward with a round brush, a little light wax.
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · Straight hair

faq.q: Why is it called comma hair?
faq.a: The fringe curls inward at the end, like a comma.

faq.q: How do I make the comma shape?
faq.a: Blow dry the fringe inward with a round brush, or use a small curling iron.

faq.q: How long should the fringe be?
faq.a: Down to the eyebrows.

faq.q: Can I get comma hair with a perm?
faq.a: Yes. A soft perm on the fringe holds the curl with less daily styling.

barberSteps: Ask: part on left or right?
Fringe: to the eyebrows, longer on one side.
Blow dry fringe inward with a round brush.

name: Korean Perm
shortLine: Soft, loose waves added to the top with a perm.
description: Soft, loose waves added to straight top hair with a perm. Volume without daily styling.
pickIf: your hair is straight and flat and you want easy volume for months.
skipIf: your hair is damaged or already curly, or your scalp is sensitive.
daily: 2 min: a little curl cream, squeeze with your fingers.
weekly: Mild shampoo and conditioner. No hair straightener.
nextVisit: in 4 weeks for a trim. The perm lasts 2–3 months.
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · Straight hair · Thin hair OK

faq.q: How long does a Korean perm last?
faq.a: About 2–3 months.

faq.q: Does a perm damage hair?
faq.a: It can make hair drier. Use mild shampoo and conditioner, and skip the perm if your hair is already damaged.

faq.q: How long does a perm take at the shop?
faq.a: 2–3 hours.

faq.q: When can I wash my hair after a perm?
faq.a: Wait 2 days before using shampoo.

barberSteps: Ask: scalp problems or allergy? If yes, stop.
Cut first: two-block or comma shape.
Roll top hair on medium perm rods.
Apply perm lotion. Wait as on the box.
Rinse. Apply neutraliser. Wait as on the box.
Remove rods. Rinse. No shampoo for 2 days.
barberNote: Best done by someone trained in perms.

name: Brush Up
shortLine: Short sides with the top brushed straight up.
description: Short sides with the top brushed straight up. Fresh, with some height.
pickIf: you want a little height without the work of a quiff.
skipIf: you have a long or heart-shaped face.
daily: 2 min: blow dry up, a little wax.
suitsText: Oval, square and round face · Straight or wavy hair · Thin hair OK

faq.q: What is the difference between a brush up and a quiff?
faq.a: A brush up has even height across the top. A quiff has more height at the front.

faq.q: How long should the top be?
faq.a: 2–3 fingers.

faq.q: What product holds a brush up?
faq.a: Wax, after blow drying the top straight up.

faq.q: Is a brush up OK for school and office?
faq.a: Yes. It's neat and not too tall.

barberSteps: Front: same length as the top.

name: Natural Curls
shortLine: Curly hair kept at medium length, shaped evenly all over.
description: Curls kept at medium length, shaped evenly so they look full and tidy.
pickIf: you have curly hair and want to show it off.
skipIf: you have straight hair, a round face or thin hair.
daily: 2 min: curl cream with your fingers. Don't brush when dry.
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · Curly or wavy hair

faq.q: How do I stop my curls from frizzing?
faq.a: Use conditioner, don't brush them when dry, and use curl cream.

faq.q: How often should curly hair be trimmed?
faq.a: Every 6 weeks to keep the shape.

faq.q: Should curly hair be cut wet or dry?
faq.a: Dry, so the barber can see each curl.

faq.q: Can straight hair be made curly?
faq.a: Only with a perm. See H37 Korean Perm.

barberSteps: Cut curls dry, one by one.
Sides: 3 fingers long. Shorter than top.
Shape the outline: round and even.

name: Shoulder Length
shortLine: Long hair worn down, reaching the shoulders.
description: Long hair worn loose to the shoulders, with light layers.
pickIf: you want long hair that looks cared for, not messy.
skipIf: you have a long face or thin hair, or a strict office.
daily: 3 min: brush, a little hair cream on the ends.
suitsText: Oval, square and heart face · Straight or wavy hair

faq.q: How long does it take to grow hair to the shoulders?
faq.a: About 1.5–2 years from a short cut, since hair grows about 1.25 cm a month.

faq.q: Do I need trims while it grows?
faq.a: Yes. Small trims every 8 weeks keep the ends healthy.

faq.q: How do I keep long hair neat?
faq.a: Brush it daily, use conditioner, and put a little hair cream on the ends.

faq.q: Is long hair OK for office?
faq.a: Not in every office. Tying it in a bun can help.

barberSteps: Ask: how much length to keep?

name: School Cut
shortLine: Short, neat cut that meets most school rules.
description: Short and tidy: ears clear, collar clear and the front above the eyebrows.
pickIf: you need a cut that meets school rules.
skipIf: you want a fashion style.
daily: 1 min: comb.
suitsText: All face shapes · All hair types · Thin hair OK

faq.q: What hair rules do schools usually have?
faq.a: Rules differ by school. Many ask for the ears and collar clear and the front above the eyebrows.

faq.q: How short is a school cut?
faq.a: Usually machine #2 on the sides and 1–2 fingers on top.

faq.q: How often does a school cut need a trim?
faq.a: Every 3–4 weeks.

faq.q: Does a school cut need any product?
faq.a: No. Just comb it.

barberSteps: Ask: any school rules for hair?
Front: above the eyebrows. Back: above the collar.

name: Pushed Back
shortLine: Medium top pushed back with a natural, matte finish.
description: Medium top pushed back with a soft, natural finish. Not shiny like a slick back.
pickIf: you want smart but relaxed hair for office and weekends.
skipIf: you have a long or heart-shaped face, or thin hair.
daily: 3 min: blow dry back, a little matte cream.
suitsText: Oval, square and round face · Straight or wavy hair

faq.q: What is the difference between pushed back and slicked back hair?
faq.a: Pushed back hair has a soft, matte finish. A slick back is shiny and combed flat.

faq.q: What product should I use?
faq.a: Matte cream or matte paste.

faq.q: How long should the top be?
faq.a: About 4 fingers.

faq.q: Does pushed back hair suit a long face?
faq.a: Not really. It shows more forehead, which makes the face look longer.

barberSteps: Sides: machine #3, taper to #2 at neck.
Front: a little longer than back.

name: Dandy Cut
shortLine: Soft, side-swept top with volume and tidy tapered sides.
description: Korean dandy cut: a soft top swept to one side with natural volume and a light fringe, over short, tidy sides. Gentle and neat.
pickIf: you want a soft, polished look for office, college or a date.
skipIf: you have very thin hair, or no time to blow dry in the morning.
daily: 4 min: blow dry the top up and to the side, a little light wax.
suitsText: Oval, square, round and heart face · Straight or wavy hair

faq.q: What is a dandy cut?
faq.a: A Korean style with a soft top swept to one side, a light fringe and short, tidy sides. It looks neat but not stiff.

faq.q: How is a dandy cut different from a side part?
faq.a: A dandy cut is softer and has more natural volume. A classic side part is combed flat and polished.

faq.q: How long should the top be?
faq.a: About 6–8 cm, with the fringe to the eyebrows.

faq.q: Do I need a blow dryer?
faq.a: Yes, for a few minutes. Blow drying lifts the roots and sets the sweep.

barberSteps: Sides and back: machine #3, taper to #2 at neck.
Ask: part on left or right?
Blow dry top up and to the side.

name: See-Through Bangs
shortLine: Thin, wispy fringe that lets a little forehead show.
description: A Korean fringe cut thin and light so the forehead shows through the strands. Soft and airy, with short, tidy sides.
pickIf: you want a soft fringe that doesn't look heavy, or want to cover a high forehead lightly.
skipIf: you have very curly hair, or don't want hair on your forehead.
daily: 3 min: blow dry the fringe down, a little light wax.
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · Straight or wavy hair · Thin hair OK

faq.q: What are see-through bangs?
faq.a: A thin, wispy fringe where the forehead shows through the strands. It is lighter than a full fringe.

faq.q: Do see-through bangs suit thin hair?
faq.a: Yes. The fringe is meant to be light, so thin hair looks natural.

faq.q: How do I stop the fringe splitting?
faq.a: Blow dry it down and a little to the side, then use a little light wax, not heavy gel.

faq.q: How long is the fringe?
faq.a: To the eyebrows, thinned out with thinning scissors.

barberSteps: Thin the fringe with thinning scissors.

name: Leaf Cut
shortLine: Centre part with layered pieces that flick out like leaves.
description: A Korean layered cut with a centre part. The fringe falls in two soft pieces that flick slightly outward at the ends, like leaves.
pickIf: you want a soft, trendy look with face-framing pieces.
skipIf: you have very short hair or curly hair, or a strict office.
daily: 5 min: blow dry the fringe outward with a round brush, a little light wax.
suitsText: Oval and heart face · Straight or wavy hair

faq.q: Why is it called a leaf cut?
faq.a: The fringe splits in the middle and each side flicks outward at the end, like the edge of a leaf.

faq.q: How long does hair need to be?
faq.a: About 8–10 cm on top, with the fringe reaching the cheekbones.

faq.q: Is a leaf cut the same as a middle part?
faq.a: It is similar, but a leaf cut has more layers and the ends flick outward.

faq.q: Does a leaf cut need a perm?
faq.a: No, but a soft perm on the fringe makes the outward flick last longer.

barberSteps: Fringe: to the cheekbones, in two pieces.
Point cut the ends so they flick out.

name: Down Perm
shortLine: Perm that keeps the sides flat and the top natural.
description: A Korean perm used on the sides to keep them flat against the head, so the top looks fuller and the hair stays neat without daily styling.
pickIf: your hair puffs out at the sides and you want a neat, slim shape for months.
skipIf: your hair is damaged or very thin, or your scalp is sensitive.
daily: 1 min: a little light wax on top.
nextVisit: in 4 weeks for a trim. The perm lasts 2–3 months.
suitsText: Oval, round, square and heart face · Straight or wavy hair

faq.q: What does a down perm do?
faq.a: It makes the hair on the sides lie flat against the head, so the top looks fuller and the shape stays neat.

faq.q: Does a down perm make hair curly?
faq.a: No. It only calms the volume at the sides. The top stays natural.

faq.q: How long does a down perm last?
faq.a: About 2–3 months.

faq.q: Is a down perm good for a round face?
faq.a: Yes. Flat sides slim the face, and the top adds height.

barberSteps: Ask: scalp problems or allergy? If yes, stop.
Apply down-perm lotion to the sides only.
Comb the sides down and back. Wait as on the box.
Rinse. Apply neutraliser. Wait as on the box.
barberNote: Best done by someone trained in perms.

name: Regent Cut
shortLine: Long top swept back from a soft part, with tapered sides.
description: A Korean cut with a long top swept back and slightly to the sides, a little lift at the front and short tapered sides. Smart and elegant.
pickIf: you want a smart, grown-up Korean look with some length.
skipIf: you have thin hair, or want a quick morning.
daily: 6 min: blow dry back, then a little pomade or light wax.
suitsText: Oval and square face · Straight or wavy hair

faq.q: What is a regent cut?
faq.a: A Korean cut with a long top swept back from a soft part, a little lift at the front and short tapered sides.

faq.q: How is a regent cut different from a slick back?
faq.a: A regent cut has a soft, natural finish with some volume. A slick back is flat and shiny.

faq.q: How long should the top be?
faq.a: About 8–10 cm.

faq.q: Which product should I use?
faq.a: A light pomade or wax, for a soft hold with a little shine.

barberSteps: Sides: machine #3, taper to #2 at neck.
Ask: part on left or right?
Front: a little longer than back.

name: Hush Cut
shortLine: Soft, feathery layers around the face.
description: A soft layered cut for medium to long hair, with feathery layers around the face and lightly thinned ends. A gentler version of the wolf cut.
pickIf: you want longer hair that looks soft and cared for, without a messy shag.
skipIf: you have very short or curly hair, or a strict office.
daily: 4 min: blow dry, a little light cream on the ends.
suitsText: Oval, round, square and heart face · Straight or wavy hair

faq.q: What is a hush cut?
faq.a: A medium-length layered cut with soft, feathery layers around the face and lightly thinned ends. It looks soft and natural.

faq.q: How is a hush cut different from a wolf cut?
faq.a: A wolf cut is choppy and messy. A hush cut is softer, with smoother layers.

faq.q: How long does hair need to be?
faq.a: At least to the ears at the sides, and to the collar or longer at the back.

faq.q: Is a hush cut good for a round face?
faq.a: Yes. Layers around the face slim it.

barberSteps: Ask: how much length to keep?
Back: keep length, to the collar.
Face layers: down to the cheeks.
Thin the ends with thinning scissors.
Blow dry. Finish with light cream.

name: Edgar Cut
shortLine: Blunt, straight fringe over a skin fade.
description: A short, thick fringe cut straight across the forehead, over sides faded to skin. Bold, sharp and modern.
pickIf: you want a bold cut with a clean, blunt edge.
skipIf: you have a round face, or can't visit every 2 weeks.
daily: 2 min: comb the fringe forward, a little dry wax (clay).
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · All hair types · Thin hair OK

faq.q: What is an Edgar cut?
faq.a: A short, blunt fringe cut straight across the forehead, over sides faded to skin.

faq.q: Does an Edgar cut work with curly hair?
faq.a: Yes. The top is kept short and the fringe is cut straight, so curls sit forward neatly.

faq.q: How long is the fringe?
faq.a: About 2–3 cm, just above the eyebrows.

faq.q: How often does it need a touch-up?
faq.a: Every 2 weeks, to keep the fade and the fringe line sharp.

barberSteps: Fade line: middle of the side, at the temple.

name: Flat Top
shortLine: Short top cut perfectly flat, with tight sides.
description: A classic cut with the top trimmed flat like a table and the sides cut very short. Strong, neat and old-school.
pickIf: you have thick, straight or curly hair and want a strong, classic look.
skipIf: you have thin or fine hair, or a long face.
daily: 2 min: brush the top up, a little firm wax.
suitsText: Oval, square and round face · Straight or curly hair

faq.q: What is a flat top?
faq.a: A short cut where the top stands up and is trimmed perfectly flat, with very short sides.

faq.q: What hair does a flat top need?
faq.a: Thick hair that stands up on its own. Fine or thin hair won't hold the shape.

faq.q: How long is the top?
faq.a: About 3 cm, brushed straight up before cutting.

faq.q: How often should I get it trimmed?
faq.a: Every 2–3 weeks, to keep the top flat and the sides tight.

barberSteps: Cut the top flat with comb and scissors.
Check the top is level from every side.

name: Natural Afro
shortLine: Full, round curls grown out and shaped evenly.
description: Tight natural curls grown out into a full, round shape, with a neat edge-up and an even outline. Strong and confident.
pickIf: you have tight curly hair and want to show off its volume.
skipIf: your hair is straight or thin, or you want a low-effort short cut.
daily: 3 min: pick the curls out, a little curl cream.
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · Curly hair

faq.q: How long does hair need to be for an afro?
faq.a: At least 8–10 cm of curls, which takes about 8–12 months from a short cut.

faq.q: How do I keep an afro healthy?
faq.a: Use conditioner 2–3 times a week and curl cream, and don't brush it dry.

faq.q: How do I get a round shape?
faq.a: Pick the curls out with a wide comb, then have the barber shape the outline evenly.

faq.q: Can an afro have faded sides?
faq.a: Yes. A low fade on the sides keeps it neat and makes the top look fuller.

barberSteps: Cut curls dry, one by one.
Pick out the curls with a wide comb.
Shape the outline: round and even.
Edge up the hairline with a trimmer.

name: Textured Fringe
shortLine: Messy, textured fringe over a low taper.
description: A short, choppy top pushed forward into a textured fringe, over a low taper on the sides. Easy, young and very popular.
pickIf: you want an easy, modern cut that looks good a little messy.
skipIf: you have a round face, or want your forehead to show.
daily: 2 min: towel dry, then push a little dry wax (clay) forward through the top.
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · Straight or wavy hair · Thin hair OK

faq.q: What is a textured fringe?
faq.a: A short top cut choppy and pushed forward, so the fringe falls over the forehead in uneven pieces.

faq.q: How is it different from a French crop?
faq.a: A French crop has a blunt, straight fringe. A textured fringe is choppy and messy, and usually a little longer.

faq.q: Does it hide a high forehead?
faq.a: Yes. The fringe covers part of the forehead, so it suits a long face or a high hairline.

faq.q: Which product should I use?
faq.a: A dry wax (clay) or sea salt spray, for a matte, textured finish.

barberSteps: Fringe: point cut for a choppy edge.
Finish with dry wax, pushed forward.

name: Hard Part
shortLine: Side part with a thin shaved line.
description: A classic side part with the parting line shaved in with a trimmer, over short tapered sides. Sharp and smart.
pickIf: you like a side part and want it sharp and clear all day.
skipIf: you have a cowlick where the part goes, or can't visit every 3 weeks.
daily: 4 min: comb to the side along the line, a little pomade.
suitsText: Oval, square, round and heart face · Straight or wavy hair · Thin hair OK

faq.q: What is a hard part?
faq.a: A side part where the barber shaves a thin line along the parting, so it stays sharp without combing.

faq.q: How long does the line last?
faq.a: About 1–2 weeks. Then it grows back and needs a touch-up.

faq.q: Which side should the part go on?
faq.a: The side where your hair falls naturally. The barber finds it by combing wet hair straight back.

faq.q: Is a hard part OK for the office?
faq.a: Yes. It looks neat and smart, as long as the line is thin.

barberSteps: Sides: machine #2, taper to #1 at neck.
Ask: part on left or right?
Shave a thin line along the part with a trimmer.
Comb to the side. Finish with pomade.

name: Temple Fade
shortLine: Small fade at the temples and nape, with a sharp line-up.
description: A small fade around the temples, sideburns and nape, with the hairline lined up sharp. The rest of the hair keeps its length.
pickIf: you want clean, sharp edges without short sides.
skipIf: you can't visit every 2 weeks.
daily: 2 min: brush or comb the top, a little wax.
suitsText: Oval, square, round and heart face · All hair types · Thin hair OK

faq.q: What is a temple fade?
faq.a: A small fade around the temples, sideburns and nape, with a sharp line-up. The rest of the sides stays longer.

faq.q: How is it different from a taper fade?
faq.a: Both are small fades. A temple fade adds a sharp line-up at the hairline and temples.

faq.q: Does it work with curly hair?
faq.a: Yes. It's popular with curly and wavy hair, because it keeps the edges neat.

faq.q: How often does it need a touch-up?
faq.a: Every 2 weeks, to keep the line-up sharp.

barberSteps: Sides: keep the length. Blend into the fade.
Line up the hairline with a trimmer.
Clean the edges with a razor.

name: V-Cut
shortLine: Neat cut with the back of the neck shaped into a V.
description: A short to medium cut with the hairline at the back of the neck cut into a sharp V. Simple at the front, a sharp detail at the back.
pickIf: you want something a little different at the back, without a bold top.
skipIf: your office needs a plain, square neck line.
daily: 2 min: comb or brush, a little wax.
suitsText: Oval, square, round and heart face · Straight or wavy hair · Thin hair OK

faq.q: What is a V-cut?
faq.a: A haircut where the hairline at the back of the neck is cut into a sharp V, pointing down.

faq.q: Can I get a V-cut with any style on top?
faq.a: Yes. The V is only at the back, so it works with a taper, a fade or a longer top.

faq.q: How long does the V stay sharp?
faq.a: About 2–3 weeks. Then the edges grow out.

faq.q: Does a V-cut make the neck look longer?
faq.a: Yes. The point draws the eye down, so the neck looks slimmer.

barberSteps: Ask: which style on top, and how deep a V?
Cut the top and sides as asked.
Mark the V point at the centre of the neck.
Cut both sides of the V with a trimmer.
Clean below the V with a razor.

name: Ponytail
shortLine: Long hair tied back low at the neck.
description: Long hair pulled back and tied low at the back of the neck. Easy, relaxed, and it keeps hair off your face.
pickIf: your hair reaches your shoulders and you want the easiest way to wear it.
skipIf: your hair is shorter than your shoulders, or thin, or you have a round face.
daily: 2 min: brush back and tie with a soft hair tie.
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · Straight or wavy hair

faq.q: How long does hair need to be for a ponytail?
faq.a: At least to the shoulders, so it can be tied at the neck.

faq.q: How is it different from a man bun?
faq.a: A ponytail hangs down from a low tie. A man bun is twisted and tied up at the back of the head.

faq.q: Will a ponytail damage my hair?
faq.a: Not if you tie it loosely with a soft hair tie and change the spot now and then.

faq.q: How often should I trim it?
faq.a: Every 8 weeks, to remove split ends.

barberSteps: Trim ends only: 1 finger or less.
Thin bulky areas at the back.
Ask: shorter layers at the front?
Comb back. Tie low to check.

name: Top Knot
shortLine: Long top tied in a knot, with short sides.
description: The hair on top is grown long and tied in a knot at the crown, with the sides and back cut short. Bold and modern.
pickIf: you want long hair on top but short, clean sides.
skipIf: your top is shorter than 15 cm, your hair is thin, or you have a long face.
daily: 3 min: brush the top back and tie a knot.
suitsText: Oval, square and round face · Straight or wavy hair

faq.q: How is a top knot different from a man bun?
faq.a: A top knot is tied higher, at the crown, and the sides are short. A man bun keeps the sides long.

faq.q: How long does the top need to be?
faq.a: At least 15 cm, so it reaches the crown when pulled back.

faq.q: Can I wear it down?
faq.a: Yes. Down, it looks like a long undercut.

faq.q: How often do the sides need cutting?
faq.a: Every 3 weeks, to keep them short and neat.

barberSteps: Tie the knot at the crown to check.

name: Half Bun
shortLine: Top half tied in a small bun, the rest left down.
description: The top half of medium to long hair is tied in a small bun at the back, and the rest hangs loose. Relaxed and easy.
pickIf: your hair reaches your chin or longer, and you want it off your face but still down.
skipIf: your hair is shorter than your chin, or thin.
daily: 2 min: gather the top half and tie a small bun.
suitsText: Oval, square and heart face · Straight or wavy hair

faq.q: How long does hair need to be for a half bun?
faq.a: At least to the chin, so the top half can be tied back.

faq.q: How is it different from a man bun?
faq.a: A man bun ties all the hair up. A half bun ties only the top half and leaves the rest down.

faq.q: Does it suit layered hair?
faq.a: Yes. Layers make the hair that hangs down look fuller.

faq.q: How often should I trim it?
faq.a: Every 6–8 weeks, to keep the ends healthy.

barberSteps: Trim ends only: 1 finger or less.
Add light layers at the back.
Tie the top half to check.

name: Dreadlocks
shortLine: Hair formed into neat, rope-like locks.
description: Hair twisted into sections and left to lock into rope-like strands, kept neat by retwisting the roots. A long-term style that takes months to form.
pickIf: you want a long-term style and are ready for months of patience.
skipIf: you like to change your look often. Locks are hard to undo without cutting.
daily: 2 min: tie back or let hang. No combing.
weekly: Wash once with a residue-free shampoo, then dry fully.
nextVisit: in 4–6 weeks, to retwist the roots
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · Curly or wavy hair

faq.q: How long do dreadlocks take to form?
faq.a: About 6–12 months for the locks to set fully, depending on your hair.

faq.q: Can straight hair form locks?
faq.a: It can, but it takes longer and needs more twisting. Curly hair locks most easily.

faq.q: How do I wash dreadlocks?
faq.a: Once a week with a residue-free shampoo. Dry them fully so they don't smell.

faq.q: Can I take them out later?
faq.a: Only with long, careful work, and it often means cutting most of the length.

barberSteps: Wash and dry the hair fully.
Part the hair into even squares.
Twist each section from root to end.
Tighten the roots with a crochet hook or palm rolling.
Ask: book a retwist in 4–6 weeks.

name: Tapered Afro
shortLine: Short, full curls on top, with sides tapered close.
description: Tight natural curls kept short and full on top, with the sides and nape tapered neatly. A cleaner, shorter take on the natural afro.
pickIf: you have tight curls and want them neat and easy to manage.
skipIf: your hair is straight or thin, or you want long curls.
daily: 3 min: pick the curls out, a little curl cream.
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · Curly hair

faq.q: What is a tapered afro?
faq.a: A short, full afro on top, with the sides and nape tapered or faded close to the head.

faq.q: How is it different from a natural afro?
faq.a: A natural afro is full and round all over. A tapered afro keeps the top full and cuts the sides short.

faq.q: How long should the top be?
faq.a: About 4–6 cm of curls, enough to show the curl but still neat.

faq.q: How often should I get it trimmed?
faq.a: Every 3–4 weeks, to keep the taper and the edges clean.

barberSteps: Sides and nape: machine #1, taper up.
Blend into the top with #2, then #3.
Pick out the curls and shape the top round.
Edge up the hairline with a trimmer.

name: Curly Curtains
shortLine: Curly hair parted in the centre, falling to both sides.
description: Medium-length curls parted down the middle and falling softly to each side of the face. A relaxed, 90s-inspired look.
pickIf: you have curly or wavy hair and want a relaxed, retro look.
skipIf: your hair is straight or thin, or you have a round face.
daily: 3 min: curl cream with your fingers, then let it dry.
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · Curly or wavy hair

faq.q: What are curly curtains?
faq.a: Medium-length curly hair parted in the centre, with the sides falling forward like curtains.

faq.q: How long does hair need to be?
faq.a: At least 7–8 cm on top, so it can part and fall over the forehead.

faq.q: Does it suit a round face?
faq.a: Not usually. The width at the sides makes a round face look rounder.

faq.q: How do I keep the curls from frizzing?
faq.a: Use conditioner, curl cream, and don’t brush them when dry.

barberSteps: Cut curls dry, one by one.
Find the centre part with a comb.
Sides: leave long enough to cover the ears.

name: Tousled Waves
shortLine: Messy, textured waves at medium length.
description: Medium-length hair with loose, natural waves left messy and textured on top. Easy, relaxed and low effort.
pickIf: you have wavy hair and want an easy, laid-back look.
skipIf: your hair is straight or thin, or you want a sharp, neat look.
daily: 2 min: scrunch in a little sea salt spray or curl cream, then let it dry.
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · Curly or wavy hair

faq.q: What are tousled waves?
faq.a: Medium-length wavy hair left loose and messy, with natural texture on top.

faq.q: What hair does it need?
faq.a: Wavy or loosely curly hair. Straight hair needs a perm or lots of styling to hold the waves.

faq.q: Which product should I use?
faq.a: Sea salt spray or a light curl cream, scrunched in, for a soft, natural hold.

faq.q: How long does hair need to be?
faq.a: About 8–10 cm on top and over the ears at the sides.

barberSteps: Cut the hair dry to see the waves.
Top: 8–10 cm. Point cut for texture.
Sides: over the ears, blended softly.
Scrunch in sea salt spray or curl cream.

name: Low Mullet
shortLine: Short on top and sides, a little longer at the back.
description: A subtle mullet: neat short sides and top, with just a little extra length at the nape. The easiest way to try the style.
pickIf: you want to try a mullet without it being obvious.
skipIf: your hair is very thin, or your office wants a plain neck line.
daily: 2 min: comb the top, a little wax.
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · Straight or wavy hair

faq.q: What is a low mullet?
faq.a: A mullet with only a little extra length at the back, so it looks like a normal short cut from the front.

faq.q: How long is the back?
faq.a: About 3–4 cm over the collar line, just touching the neck.

faq.q: Is it good for a first mullet?
faq.a: Yes. It grows out easily and can be cut shorter at any time.

faq.q: How often should I trim it?
faq.a: Every 3–4 weeks to keep the sides tidy and the back shaped.

barberSteps: Sides: machine #2, blend up to the top.
Back: leave 3–4 cm longer than the sides.
Shape the back into a soft point at the nape.
Clean the ears and neck edges.

name: Mid Mullet
shortLine: Balanced mullet, back reaching the collar.
description: The classic balance: a shaped top, tidy sides and a back that reaches the collar. Clearly a mullet, but still neat.
pickIf: you want a clear mullet that still looks tidy and modern.
skipIf: your hair is thin, or you want an everyday short cut.
daily: 3 min: blow dry, a little texture cream.
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · Straight or wavy hair

faq.q: What is a mid mullet?
faq.a: A mullet with a balanced length: short sides and a back that reaches the collar.

faq.q: How long is the top?
faq.a: About 6–8 cm, with a little texture on top.

faq.q: How is it different from a low mullet?
faq.a: A mid mullet shows its back length clearly, while a low mullet is subtle.

faq.q: Which product should I use?
faq.a: A texture cream or light wax for soft, natural movement.

barberSteps: Top: 6–8 cm. Scissors and point cut.
Back: leave to the collar, 8–10 cm.
Connect the top to the back with soft layers.
Clean the ears and the side edges.

name: High Mullet
shortLine: Very short sides, a long back, strong contrast.
description: A bold mullet with sides faded high up and a long back, so the contrast between short and long is sharp and clear.
pickIf: you want a bold, high-contrast cut that stands out.
skipIf: you have thin hair, a long face, or a strict office.
daily: 4 min: blow dry, texture spray, shape the back.
suitsText: Oval and square face · Straight or wavy hair

faq.q: What is a high mullet?
faq.a: A mullet with the sides faded high up the head, so the long back stands out strongly.

faq.q: How long should the back be?
faq.a: At least 12–15 cm, to the collar or lower.

faq.q: How often does it need a trim?
faq.a: Every 3 weeks, to keep the fade sharp.

faq.q: Does it suit a long face?
faq.a: Not usually. The long back adds more length, so oval or square faces suit it better.

barberSteps: Fade the sides high: #0 to #3 up to the temple.
Top: 7–9 cm. Scissors and point cut.
Connect the top to the back with layers.

name: Full Mullet
shortLine: Short on top and sides, long to the shoulders at the back.
description: The full version: short top and sides with a long back that reaches the shoulders. Big, bold and unmistakably a mullet.
pickIf: you want the full mullet look and have the hair for it.
skipIf: you have thin hair, a round face, or want a low-effort cut.
daily: 4 min: wash and air dry, a little sea salt spray.
suitsText: Oval, square and heart face · Straight or wavy hair

faq.q: What is a full mullet?
faq.a: A mullet with a short top and sides and a back that reaches the shoulders.

faq.q: How long does it take to grow?
faq.a: About 8–12 months from a short cut, to reach shoulder length at the back.

faq.q: Can the front be styled?
faq.a: Yes. Keep it short and tidy, or add a fringe for a softer look.

faq.q: How do I keep the back healthy?
faq.a: Conditioner 2–3 times a week and a trim every 6–8 weeks to remove split ends.

barberSteps: Back: keep the full length, to the shoulders.
Trim the ends only: 1 finger or less.
Blend the top into the back with long layers.

name: Korean Mullet
shortLine: Soft, layered mullet with a light fringe.
description: A softer take on the mullet: light layers, a wispy fringe and a longer back, with tidy tapered sides. Stylish without being rough.
pickIf: you want a soft, trendy mullet with a Korean look.
skipIf: you have thin or curly hair, or a round face.
daily: 5 min: blow dry, a little light wax.
suitsText: Oval, long and heart face · Straight hair

faq.q: What is a Korean mullet?
faq.a: A mullet with soft layers, a wispy fringe and a longer back, cut to look clean and light.

faq.q: How is it different from a modern mullet?
faq.a: A Korean mullet is softer and lighter, with a see-through fringe and gentle layers.

faq.q: How long is the back?
faq.a: About 8–10 cm, reaching the collar.

faq.q: Does it work with thin hair?
faq.a: It can be hard. The layers need enough hair to look full.

barberSteps: Sides: machine #3, taper to #2 at the neck.
Fringe: thin and wispy, to the eyebrows.
Back: leave 8–10 cm, with soft layers.
Thin the ends with thinning scissors.
Blow dry. Finish with light wax.

name: Greaser
shortLine: Shiny, combed-back quiff with short, tight sides.
description: A classic 1950s cut: a high, shiny, combed-back top with short tapered sides, held in place with pomade. Bold and retro.
pickIf: you like a retro look and enjoy daily styling.
skipIf: you have thin hair, or want something quick.
daily: 8 min: comb in strong-hold pomade, shape the top back, set with a comb.
weekly: Wash the pomade out well. Conditioner once.
suitsText: Oval, square and heart face · Straight or wavy hair

faq.q: What is a greaser haircut?
faq.a: A 1950s cut with a high, shiny, combed-back top and short, tight sides.

faq.q: Which product should I use?
faq.a: A strong-hold pomade, combed through from roots to ends for a high shine.

faq.q: How long does the top need to be?
faq.a: About 8–10 cm, long enough to comb back and lift.

faq.q: How do I wash out pomade?
faq.a: Use a clarifying shampoo once a week, because pomade builds up.

barberSteps: Back: tapered, with a clean neck line.
Comb the top back and up.
Add a little height at the front.
Set with strong pomade and a comb.

name: Curly Crop
shortLine: Short, tight curls on top with a neat taper.
description: Short curls cropped close on top, with the sides tapered neatly. Clean and easy, and it shows off natural curl pattern.
pickIf: you have curly hair and want a short, low-effort cut.
skipIf: your hair is straight, or you want long curls.
daily: 2 min: curl cream with your fingers.
suitsText: Oval, square, round and heart face · Curly or wavy hair · Thin hair OK

faq.q: What is a curly crop?
faq.a: A short cut for curly hair, with the curls cropped close on top and the sides tapered.

faq.q: How long is the top?
faq.a: About 3–4 cm, short enough to be easy and long enough to show the curl.

faq.q: How is it different from a curly top fade?
faq.a: A curly crop is shorter and simpler. A curly top fade keeps longer curls over a skin fade.

faq.q: How do I stop frizz?
faq.a: Use a little curl cream and don’t brush it when dry.

barberSteps: Sides: machine #2, taper to #1 at the neck.
Cut the curls on top dry, 3–4 cm.
Shape the top into a neat round outline.
Blend the sides into the top.
Edge up the hairline with a trimmer.

name: Angular Fringe
shortLine: Short fringe cut at a sharp diagonal angle.
description: A short fringe cut on a sharp diagonal across the forehead, over tidy short sides. Modern and easy.
pickIf: you want a fringe that looks sharp and modern.
skipIf: you have a very high forehead and want it covered fully, or you want a soft look.
daily: 2 min: comb the fringe across, a little clay.
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · Straight or wavy hair · Thin hair OK

faq.q: What is an angular fringe?
faq.a: A fringe cut at a diagonal angle, so it sits higher on one side and lower on the other.

faq.q: How long is the fringe?
faq.a: About 3–4 cm on the long side, reaching the eyebrow.

faq.q: Does it suit thin hair?
faq.a: Yes. A short, sharp fringe looks neat even on finer hair.

faq.q: How often do I need a trim?
faq.a: Every 3 weeks to keep the angle sharp.

barberSteps: Sides: machine #2, taper to #1 at neck.
Comb the fringe across the forehead.
Cut the fringe at a diagonal angle.
Point cut for a soft edge.

name: Asymmetrical Cut
shortLine: One side longer than the other, swept across.
description: A cut with one side left longer and swept across the forehead, and the other side cut short. Creative, but easy to wear.
pickIf: you want a cut that is a little different and still easy to wear.
skipIf: you want a perfectly even look, or you have a strict office.
daily: 4 min: blow dry the long side across, a little paste.
suitsText: Oval, square, round and heart face · Straight or wavy hair

faq.q: What is an asymmetrical cut?
faq.a: A cut where one side is longer than the other, so the top sweeps across to one side.

faq.q: Which side should be longer?
faq.a: The side where your hair naturally falls, which the barber finds with your part.

faq.q: Does it suit a round face?
faq.a: Yes. The diagonal line adds angles and makes the face look longer.

faq.q: How do I style it?
faq.a: Blow dry the long side across and set it with a little paste.

barberSteps: Ask: which side long, which side short?
Short side: machine #2, taper at the ear.
Long side: 6–8 cm, left to sweep across.
Blend the top into both sides.
Point cut the swept edge for softness.
Blow dry across. Finish with paste.

name: Blowout Taper
shortLine: Full, blow-dried top over a clean taper.
description: A full, voluminous top blow-dried up and back, with the sides tapered neatly. Lots of body, clean edges.
pickIf: you want a full, fluffy top that still looks neat on the sides.
skipIf: your hair is very thin or flat, or you do not want to use a dryer.
daily: 5 min: blow dry the top up and back, a little light cream.
suitsText: Oval, square, round and heart face · Straight or wavy hair

faq.q: What is a blowout taper?
faq.a: A taper on the sides with a longer top that is blow-dried for height and volume.

faq.q: How long is the top?
faq.a: About 7–9 cm, long enough to lift and sweep back.

faq.q: Do I need a hair dryer?
faq.a: Yes. The volume comes from blow drying the hair up and back with a brush.

faq.q: Does it suit a round face?
faq.a: Yes. The height on top makes the face look longer.

barberSteps: Sides: machine #2, taper to #1 at neck.
Blend the top into the taper.
Blow dry the top up and back with a brush.
Finish with light cream or spray.

name: Curtain Fringe
shortLine: Centre-parted fringe falling softly to both sides.
description: Medium-length hair parted in the centre, with the fringe falling softly to each side like curtains. Easy, relaxed and flattering.
pickIf: you want a soft, easy look that frames the face.
skipIf: you have very curly hair (see Curly Curtains), or thin hair.
daily: 3 min: blow dry the fringe apart, a little cream.
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · Straight or wavy hair

faq.q: What is a curtain fringe?
faq.a: A fringe parted in the centre that falls to both sides of the face, like curtains.

faq.q: How long does hair need to be?
faq.a: At least 7–8 cm on top, so it can part and fall past the eyebrows.

faq.q: Does it suit a round face?
faq.a: Not usually. The width at the sides can make a round face look rounder.

faq.q: How do I style it?
faq.a: Blow dry the fringe apart with your fingers, then use a little cream.

barberSteps: Find the centre part with a comb.
Cut the fringe long enough to fall past the eyebrows.
Point cut for a soft edge.
Blow dry apart. Finish with cream.

name: Layered Long Cut
shortLine: Long hair with layers for movement and shape.
description: Long hair cut in layers, so it moves and sits better instead of hanging flat. Reaches the shoulders or lower.
pickIf: you have long hair and want it to look fuller and lighter.
skipIf: your hair is very thin, or you want to keep every inch of length.
daily: 3 min: brush, a little leave-in conditioner.
suitsText: Oval, square and heart face · Straight or wavy hair

faq.q: What is a layered long cut?
faq.a: Long hair cut in layers, so shorter pieces sit over longer ones and add movement.

faq.q: Will I lose length?
faq.a: Only a little. The barber takes about 1–2 cm to create the layers.

faq.q: Does it make thin hair look fuller?
faq.a: Light layers can add body, but too many can make thin hair look thinner.

faq.q: How often should I trim it?
faq.a: Every 8 weeks, to keep the layers shaped and remove split ends.

barberSteps: Ask: how much length to keep?
Wash and comb the hair out.
Cut face-framing layers to the chin.
Cut long layers through the back.
Blow dry. Finish with leave-in conditioner.

name: Shaggy Cut
shortLine: Messy, choppy layers with a relaxed shape.
description: Choppy, uneven layers over the whole head with a messy, lived-in finish. Relaxed and full of texture.
pickIf: you want a messy, easy look with lots of texture.
skipIf: you want a neat, tidy look, or have very thin hair.
daily: 2 min: tousle with your fingers, a little sea salt spray.
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · Straight or wavy hair

faq.q: What is a shaggy cut?
faq.a: A cut with choppy, uneven layers that gives a messy, textured look.

faq.q: How is it different from a wolf cut?
faq.a: A wolf cut has a strong volume on top and a longer back. A shaggy cut is lighter and more even.

faq.q: Does it need a lot of styling?
faq.a: No. A little sea salt spray and your fingers are enough.

faq.q: How long does hair need to be?
faq.a: At least 8–10 cm on top and over the ears.

barberSteps: Ask: how much length to keep?
Cut the top in choppy layers, 8–10 cm.
Point cut the fringe and the ends.
Cut layers around the ears and neck.
Thin the bulk with thinning scissors.

name: Bro Flow
shortLine: Swept-back flowing hair, ears and neck covered.
description: Medium to long hair that flows back and over the ears, with a natural, easy shape. Relaxed and effortless.
pickIf: you want an easy, grown-out look with length.
skipIf: your hair is thin, or you want something short and sharp.
daily: 2 min: comb back, a little light cream.
suitsText: Oval, square and heart face · Straight or wavy hair

faq.q: What is a bro flow?
faq.a: Medium to long hair grown out and swept back, flowing over the ears and neck.

faq.q: How long does hair need to be?
faq.a: At least 12–15 cm, long enough to flow back past the ears.

faq.q: How do I keep it neat?
faq.a: Trim the ends every 8 weeks and use conditioner to keep it smooth.

faq.q: Does it suit a round face?
faq.a: Not usually. The extra width at the sides can make it look rounder.

barberSteps: Add light layers around the face.
Comb the hair back over the ears.
Finish with a little light cream.

name: Broccoli Cut
shortLine: Round, full top with short, tidy sides.
description: A full, rounded top that looks like the head of a broccoli, over short sides. Soft, boyish and easy.
pickIf: you want a soft, full top that is easy to wake up to.
skipIf: your hair is thin or flat, or you want a sharp look.
daily: 3 min: tousle the top, a little light cream.
suitsText: Oval, square and heart face · Straight or wavy hair

faq.q: What is a broccoli cut?
faq.a: A cut with a full, rounded top, like the head of a broccoli, and short, tidy sides.

faq.q: How long is the top?
faq.a: About 7–9 cm, long enough to build a full, round shape.

faq.q: Does it need a lot of styling?
faq.a: No. A little cream and your fingers are enough.

faq.q: Does it suit a round face?
faq.a: Not usually. The round top adds width. Oval and square faces suit it better.

barberSteps: Shape the top into a round outline.
Blend the top into the sides.
Finish with a little light cream.

name: Fluffy Hair
shortLine: Soft, airy top with natural body.
description: Soft, airy hair that sits full and light, with natural volume and a gentle fringe. Easy and boyish.
pickIf: you want soft, light hair with natural volume.
skipIf: your hair is very oily or flat, or you want a sleek look.
daily: 3 min: blow dry the top up, a little light powder or spray.
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · Straight or wavy hair

faq.q: What is fluffy hair?
faq.a: Soft, light hair with natural volume, not slicked down or heavy.

faq.q: How do I get the fluff?
faq.a: Blow dry the hair up with your fingers and use a light volume spray or powder.

faq.q: Does it need product?
faq.a: Only a little. Heavy products flatten it, so keep it light.

faq.q: Does it work with thin hair?
faq.a: It can, if the layers are light. Heavy layers make thin hair look thinner.

barberSteps: Blow dry the top up and forward.

name: Surfer Hair
shortLine: Loose, sun-kissed waves with a beachy feel.
description: Loose, wavy hair with a salty, windswept texture and a relaxed, beachy feel. Natural and easy.
pickIf: you have wavy hair and want a relaxed, beachy look.
skipIf: your hair is very straight or thin, or you want a neat, sharp cut.
daily: 2 min: scrunch in sea salt spray and air dry.
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · Wavy or curly hair

faq.q: What is surfer hair?
faq.a: Loose, wavy, medium-to-long hair with a windswept, beachy texture.

faq.q: How do I get the beachy look?
faq.a: Scrunch in sea salt spray when your hair is damp and let it air dry.

faq.q: Does it need to be long?
faq.a: About 10–15 cm on top, so the waves have room to fall.

faq.q: Does straight hair work?
faq.a: It is harder. Straight hair needs a perm or heavy styling to hold the waves.

barberSteps: Cut the hair dry to see the waves.
Keep the sides long, over the ears.
Scrunch in sea salt spray. Air dry.

name: Warrior Cut
shortLine: Long fringe with tidy short sides and a strong shape.
description: A long, heavy fringe over short, clean sides, giving a strong, dramatic shape. Bold and sharp.
pickIf: you want a strong, dramatic cut with a bold fringe.
skipIf: you have thin or curly hair, or hate hair in your eyes.
daily: 4 min: blow dry the fringe forward, a little clay.
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · Straight hair

faq.q: What is a warrior cut?
faq.a: A cut with a long, heavy fringe over short, clean sides, for a strong, dramatic shape.

faq.q: How long is the fringe?
faq.a: About 8–10 cm, falling over the forehead to the eyebrows or lower.

faq.q: Does it suit thin hair?
faq.a: Not usually. The fringe needs thick, straight hair to look full and heavy.

faq.q: How do I style it?
faq.a: Blow dry the fringe forward and set it with a little clay.

barberSteps: Sides: machine #2, taper to #1 at neck.
Fringe: cut long and heavy, to the eyebrows.
Blend the top into the short sides.
Point cut for a softer edge.
Blow dry forward. Finish with clay.

name: Spin Swallow Perm
shortLine: Korean perm with a swirl of curls pushed to the sides.
description: A Korean perm where the top is curled in a spiral and swept to the sides, like the swirling flight of a swallow. Full, soft and eye-catching.
pickIf: you have straight hair and want a Korean look with lots of movement.
skipIf: your hair is damaged, or your scalp is sensitive.
daily: 4 min: blow dry, a little curl cream or wax.
weekly: Mild shampoo and conditioner. Moisture mask once.
nextVisit: in 4 weeks, for a trim. The perm lasts 2–3 months.
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · Straight hair · Thin hair OK

faq.q: What is a spin swallow perm?
faq.a: A Korean perm that gives the top a spiral swirl, swept out to the sides.

faq.q: How long does the perm last?
faq.a: About 2–3 months, then the curls loosen as the hair grows.

faq.q: Will it suit thin hair?
faq.a: Yes. The curls add volume, so thin hair looks fuller.

faq.q: How do I care for permed hair?
faq.a: Use mild shampoo, a moisture mask once a week, and don’t brush it when dry.

barberSteps: Wind the top in a spiral on perm rods.
Apply perm solution. Wait time: as on the box.
Rinse, neutralise. Style with curl cream.

name: Off-Centre Part
shortLine: Part set just off the middle, with a natural sweep.
description: A part set slightly to one side of the middle, so the hair sweeps naturally to each side. A modern, relaxed take on the side part.
pickIf: you want a neat look that is softer than a hard side part.
skipIf: you have a strong cowlick at the part.
daily: 3 min: comb the part, a little light cream.
suitsText: Oval, square, round and heart face · Straight or wavy hair · Thin hair OK

faq.q: What is an off-centre part?
faq.a: A part set slightly off the middle, so more hair falls to one side than the other.

faq.q: How is it different from a middle part?
faq.a: A middle part is exactly even. An off-centre part sits a little to one side.

faq.q: How is it different from a side part?
faq.a: A side part sits further over. An off-centre part is closer to the middle.

faq.q: Which side should I part?
faq.a: The side where your hair naturally falls. The barber finds it by combing wet hair straight back.

barberSteps: Sides: machine #3, taper to #2 at neck.
Find the natural part with a comb.
Set the part just off the middle.
Blend the top into the sides.
Comb it in. Finish with light cream.

name: Shadow Perm
shortLine: Light, subtle waves for soft texture and volume.
description: A light Korean perm that adds soft, subtle waves and a shadowy texture, mostly at the roots and top. Natural-looking volume with little effort.
pickIf: you want soft volume and texture without obvious curls.
skipIf: your hair is damaged, or you want tight curls.
daily: 3 min: scrunch in a little light cream and air dry.
weekly: Mild shampoo and conditioner. Moisture mask once.
nextVisit: in 4–6 weeks, for a trim. The perm lasts 2–3 months.
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · Straight hair · Thin hair OK

faq.q: What is a shadow perm?
faq.a: A very light Korean perm that gives soft waves and volume, mostly on the top and at the roots.

faq.q: How is it different from a Korean perm?
faq.a: A shadow perm is lighter and subtler, with looser waves and less curl.

faq.q: Does it suit thin hair?
faq.a: Yes. The extra volume makes thin hair look fuller.

faq.q: How long does it last?
faq.a: About 2–3 months, fading as the hair grows.

barberSteps: Wind the top loosely on large rods.
Apply perm solution. Wait time: as on the box.
Rinse, neutralise. Style with light cream.

name: Nerd Perm
shortLine: Soft, round curls with a neat, boyish shape.
description: Soft, rounded perm curls over the whole top, with a neat outline and a light fringe. Cute, boyish and easy.
pickIf: you have straight hair and want soft, rounded curls.
skipIf: your hair is damaged, or you want a sharp, adult look.
daily: 3 min: scrunch in curl cream and air dry.
weekly: Mild shampoo and conditioner. Moisture mask once.
nextVisit: in 4 weeks, for a trim. The perm lasts 2–3 months.
suitsText: Oval, square and heart face · Straight hair · Thin hair OK

faq.q: What is a nerd perm?
faq.a: A perm with soft, rounded curls over the top and a neat, boyish outline.

faq.q: Does it suit a round face?
faq.a: Not usually. The round shape adds width. Oval, square and heart faces suit it better.

faq.q: How long is the top?
faq.a: About 8–9 cm before perming.

faq.q: How long does it last?
faq.a: About 2–3 months.

barberSteps: Wind the top on medium rods in an even round pattern.
Apply perm solution. Wait time: as on the box.
Rinse, neutralise. Style with curl cream.

name: Korean Fade
shortLine: Clean fade on the sides with a soft, textured top.
description: A clean fade on the sides and back, with a soft, textured top that falls forward a little. Sharp edges with a soft Korean finish.
pickIf: you want clean, short sides with a soft, stylish top.
skipIf: you cannot visit every 2–3 weeks.
daily: 3 min: blow dry the top forward, a little light wax.
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · Straight or wavy hair · Thin hair OK

faq.q: What is a Korean fade?
faq.a: A clean fade on the sides and back, with a soft, textured top that falls forward.

faq.q: How is it different from a normal fade?
faq.a: The top is longer, softer and more textured, often with a see-through fringe.

faq.q: How long is the top?
faq.a: About 6–8 cm.

faq.q: How often does it need a touch-up?
faq.a: Every 2–3 weeks, to keep the fade clean.

barberSteps: Fade the sides: #0 to #3, up to the temple.
Cut soft layers and a light fringe.
Blend the top into the fade.
Clean the neck line with a trimmer.
Blow dry forward. Finish with light wax.

name: Permed Waves
shortLine: Loose, permed waves with natural movement.
description: Loose waves created with a perm, giving natural-looking movement and body to straight hair. Soft, easy and low effort.
pickIf: you have straight hair and want easy, natural-looking waves.
skipIf: your hair is damaged, or your scalp is sensitive.
daily: 2 min: scrunch in a little curl cream and air dry.
weekly: Mild shampoo and conditioner. Moisture mask once.
nextVisit: in 6 weeks, for a trim. The perm lasts 3–4 months.
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · Straight or wavy hair

faq.q: What are permed waves?
faq.a: Loose waves created with a perm, so straight hair looks naturally wavy.

faq.q: How is it different from a Korean perm?
faq.a: Permed waves are looser and more natural, with a longer length. A Korean perm is shorter and more shaped.

faq.q: How long does it last?
faq.a: About 3–4 months, loosening as the hair grows.

faq.q: How do I care for it?
faq.a: Use mild shampoo and curl cream, and don’t brush it when dry.

barberSteps: Wind the hair on large rods for loose waves.
Apply perm solution. Wait time: as on the box.
Rinse, neutralise. Style with curl cream.

name: Layered Undercut Sweep
shortLine: Layered top swept to the side over a short undercut.
description: A layered top swept to one side with texture and movement, over short undercut sides. Stylish and full of shape.
pickIf: you want a styled, sweeping top with clean short sides.
skipIf: you have thin hair, or you do not want daily styling.
daily: 5 min: blow dry the top across, a little clay or paste.
suitsText: Oval, square, round and heart face · Straight or wavy hair

faq.q: What is a layered undercut sweep?
faq.a: A layered top swept to one side over short, clean undercut sides.

faq.q: How long is the top?
faq.a: About 8–10 cm, long enough to sweep across.

faq.q: How is it different from a normal undercut?
faq.a: The top has light layers for texture and movement, and it is swept to the side.

faq.q: Which product should I use?
faq.a: A matte clay or paste, for a strong hold without too much shine.

barberSteps: Sides: machine #1, with a clear line at the top.
Ask: sweep to the left or right?
Blend the layers into the undercut line.
Blow dry across. Finish with clay.

name: Korean Ivy League
shortLine: Neat Ivy League with a soft, natural Korean finish.
description: A neat, short side-parted cut with a little extra softness on top and a light fringe. Smart like an Ivy League, but easier and softer.
pickIf: you want a clean, smart cut that looks soft, not stiff.
skipIf: you want a sharp or bold look.
daily: 3 min: comb the part, a little light wax.
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · Straight or wavy hair · Thin hair OK

faq.q: What is a Korean Ivy League?
faq.a: A short, side-parted Ivy League cut with a softer top and a light fringe.

faq.q: How is it different from a normal Ivy League?
faq.a: The top is softer and more textured, with a see-through fringe, so it looks less formal.

faq.q: How long is the top?
faq.a: About 4–6 cm.

faq.q: Is it good for the office?
faq.a: Yes. It looks neat and smart, with a softer feel.

barberSteps: Sides: machine #2, taper to #1 at neck.
Find the part and comb the top to the side.
Blend the top into the sides.
Comb it in. Finish with light wax.

name: K-Pop Cut
shortLine: Soft, layered Korean idol style with a light fringe.
description: The popular Korean idol look: soft, layered hair with a light, see-through fringe, tidy sides and a smooth, glossy finish.
pickIf: you want the soft, polished Korean look that is popular right now.
skipIf: your hair is very thick and coarse, or you want a rough, messy look.
daily: 5 min: blow dry the fringe in place, a little light wax.
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · Straight or wavy hair · Thin hair OK

faq.q: What is a K-pop cut?
faq.a: A soft, layered Korean idol style with a light fringe, tidy sides and a smooth finish.

faq.q: How long is the top?
faq.a: About 7–9 cm, with a see-through fringe to the eyebrows.

faq.q: Which product should I use?
faq.a: A light wax or cream, for a soft hold and a natural gloss.

faq.q: Does it work with thick hair?
faq.a: Yes, but the barber thins it out first so the layers fall softly.

barberSteps: Sides: machine #3, taper to #2 at neck.
Fringe: light and see-through, to the eyebrows.
Thin the ends with thinning scissors.
Blend the top into the sides.
Blow dry the fringe into place. Light wax.

name: Low Fade Quiff
shortLine: A quiff with a low fade that starts just above the ear.
description: A Quiff on top with a low fade at the sides. The fade starts just above the ear and stays low, so the cut looks neat but not too short.
pickIf: you want height on top with a softer, more natural fade.
skipIf: you have a long or heart-shaped face, thin hair, or no time to blow dry.
daily: 5 min: blow dry the front up and back, then wax.
suitsText: Oval, square and round face · Straight or wavy hair

faq.q: What is a low fade quiff?
faq.a: A quiff on top with a fade that starts low, just above the ear, and drops to the neck.

faq.q: How is it different from a mid fade quiff?
faq.a: The fade starts lower, so more hair stays on the sides and the shape is softer.

faq.q: Can I wear it to the office?
faq.a: Yes. It looks neat, and a low fade grows out easily.

faq.q: How often do I need a trim?
faq.a: Every 3–4 weeks to keep the fade clean.

barberSteps: Sides: low fade, starting just above the ear, #1 to #3.
Blend the fade into the top.
Blow dry the front up and back.
Finish with wax. Clean neck and ears.

name: Mid Fade Quiff
shortLine: A quiff with a mid fade that starts at the temple.
description: A Quiff on top with a mid fade at the sides. The fade starts at the temple, halfway up the head, for a clear, sharp contrast with the lifted top.
pickIf: you want a bolder fade and clear height on top.
skipIf: you have a long or heart-shaped face, thin hair, or no time to blow dry.
daily: 5 min: blow dry the front up and back, then wax.
suitsText: Oval, square and round face · Straight or wavy hair

faq.q: What is a mid fade quiff?
faq.a: A quiff on top with a fade that starts at the temple, halfway up the side of the head.

faq.q: Is a mid fade quiff high maintenance?
faq.a: A little. The fade grows out in about 3 weeks, so a regular trim keeps it sharp.

faq.q: Does it suit a round face?
faq.a: Yes. Height on top and short sides make a round face look longer.

faq.q: What product holds it?
faq.a: Wax or clay. Blow dry first for height that lasts.

barberSteps: Sides: mid fade, starting at the temple, skin to #3.
Blend the fade into the top.
Blow dry the front up and back.
Finish with wax. Clean neck and ears.

name: High Fade Quiff
shortLine: A quiff with a high fade that starts near the top of the head.
description: A Quiff on top with a high fade at the sides. The fade starts high, near the temple line, for the sharpest, most dramatic contrast.
pickIf: you want a sharp, bold look with strong contrast.
skipIf: you have a round or heart-shaped face, thin hair, a strict workplace, or no time to blow dry.
daily: 5 min: blow dry the front up and back, then wax.
suitsText: Oval and square face · Straight or wavy hair

faq.q: What is a high fade quiff?
faq.a: A quiff on top with a fade that starts high on the head, close to the temple line.

faq.q: Is it too short at the sides?
faq.a: The sides are very short, so it is a bold look. A mid fade is softer.

faq.q: How often do I need a trim?
faq.a: Every 2–3 weeks. A high fade shows regrowth quickly.

faq.q: Does it suit every face?
faq.a: It suits oval and square faces best. The short sides can make a round face look wider.

barberSteps: Sides: high fade, starting high near the temple, skin to #2.
Blend the fade into the top.
Blow dry the front up and back.
Finish with wax. Clean neck and ears.

name: Taper Fade Quiff
shortLine: A quiff with a clean taper at the sideburns and neck.
description: A Quiff on top with a taper fade at the sides. Only the sideburns and neck are tapered short, so the sides keep their length and look natural.
pickIf: you want height on top with a soft, tidy, office-friendly finish.
skipIf: you have a long or heart-shaped face, thin hair, or no time to blow dry.
daily: 5 min: blow dry the front up and back, then wax.
suitsText: Oval, square and round face · Straight or wavy hair

faq.q: What is a taper fade quiff?
faq.a: A quiff on top with a gentle taper only at the sideburns and neck. The sides stay longer than in a skin fade.

faq.q: How is it different from a low fade quiff?
faq.a: A taper is smaller and softer. A low fade shows more bare skin above the ear.

faq.q: Is it good for the office?
faq.a: Yes. It is the most conservative of the quiffs.

faq.q: How often do I need a trim?
faq.a: Every 4 weeks. A taper grows out softly.

barberSteps: Sides: taper, #3 at the sides blending to #1 at the sideburns and neck.
Blend the taper into the top.
Blow dry the front up and back.
Finish with wax. Clean neck and ears.

name: Textured Quiff
shortLine: A loose, matte quiff with natural texture.
description: A relaxed Quiff with a matte, textured finish. The top is lifted but loose and a little messy, with short tapered sides. Less styling than a classic quiff.
pickIf: you want height on top without a stiff, shiny look.
skipIf: you have a long or heart-shaped face, very thin hair, or want a slick, polished finish.
daily: 3 min: sea-salt spray or clay, then push the top up with your fingers.
suitsText: Oval, square and round face · Straight or wavy hair

faq.q: What is a textured quiff?
faq.a: A quiff with a loose, matte finish. The top is lifted and a little messy, not slick.

faq.q: Do I need a blow dryer?
faq.a: Not always. Clay or sea-salt spray and your fingers are enough for a relaxed look.

faq.q: Which product is best?
faq.a: Matte clay or sea-salt spray. Avoid shiny pomade.

faq.q: Does it work on straight hair?
faq.a: Yes, but fine straight hair needs more spray or powder to hold the texture.

barberSteps: Sides: taper, #2 blending to #1 at the neck.
Top front: 4 fingers long, cut with texture.
Point-cut the top for a loose, textured finish.
Blow dry the front up, roughly.
Finish with clay. Clean neck and ears.

name: Iron Perm
shortLine: A soft Korean perm with root lift and gentle bends.
description: A Korean perm that gives the hair soft, loose bends and lift at the roots. From a distance it looks almost straight, but it has body and movement and sets easily in the morning.
pickIf: you want a polished, soft Korean look that styles itself.
skipIf: your hair is very curly, or already damaged by bleach.
daily: 3 min: blow dry with your fingers, then a little light wax.
weekly: Conditioner once. Use a heat protector if you blow dry daily.
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · Straight or wavy hair · Thin hair OK

faq.q: What is an iron perm?
faq.a: A perm that gives soft, loose bends and lift at the roots instead of tight curls.

faq.q: How long does it last?
faq.a: About 3–5 months. The effect softens as the hair grows.

faq.q: Will it damage my hair?
faq.a: A perm is a chemical treatment. Go to an experienced stylist and condition once a week.

faq.q: Can I style it without heat?
faq.a: Yes. Air dry it and add a little wax.

barberSteps: Sides: machine #3, taper to #2 at the neck.
Wrap the top on small rods and apply the perm lotion.
Blow dry the top up at the roots.

name: Baby Perm
shortLine: Small, soft waves that add fluffy volume to short hair.
description: A light Korean perm with small, soft curls that give short hair a fluffy, boyish volume. The curls are loose and natural, not tight.
pickIf: your hair is flat, thin or straight and you want easy volume.
skipIf: your hair is already very curly, or you want a slick finish.
daily: 2 min: scrunch with a little cream or sea-salt spray.
weekly: Conditioner once. Do not brush it when dry.
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · Straight or wavy hair · Thin hair OK

faq.q: What is a baby perm?
faq.a: A light perm with small, soft curls that add fluffy volume to short hair.

faq.q: Is it good for thin hair?
faq.a: Yes. The small curls add body, and the volume makes thin hair look fuller.

faq.q: How long does it last?
faq.a: About 3–4 months, and it grows out softly.

faq.q: How do I style it?
faq.a: Scrunch in a little cream, then let it dry naturally. Do not brush it.

barberSteps: Sides: machine #3, taper to #2 at the neck.
Wrap the top on very small rods and apply the perm lotion.
Shape a short fringe to the forehead.
Scrunch in cream and let it dry.

name: C-Curl Perm
shortLine: A perm where the ends curl inward in a soft C shape.
description: A Korean perm with a soft C-shaped curve at the ends of the fringe and top. It frames the face and gives a polished, sweet look.
pickIf: you want a soft, face-framing look.
skipIf: your hair is very short on top, or very thick and coarse.
daily: 4 min: blow dry the ends inward with a round brush, then light wax.
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · Straight or wavy hair · Thin hair OK

faq.q: What is a C-curl perm?
faq.a: A perm where the ends of the hair curl inward in a soft C shape.

faq.q: How is it different from an S-curl perm?
faq.a: A C-curl has one soft bend at the ends. An S-curl has waves through the whole top.

faq.q: Does it need a lot of styling?
faq.a: A little. Blow dry the ends inward and add light wax.

faq.q: How long does it last?
faq.a: About 3–5 months.

barberSteps: Sides: machine #3, taper to #2 at the neck.
Wrap the ends inward on rods and apply the perm lotion.
Cut a medium fringe to the eyebrows.
Blow dry the ends inward. Light wax.

name: S-Curl Perm
shortLine: A perm with soft S-shaped waves through the top.
description: A Korean perm that gives the top soft, flowing S-shaped waves. More movement than a C-curl, with a relaxed, natural feel.
pickIf: you want waves with movement that look natural.
skipIf: you want a neat, flat look, or your hair is very short.
daily: 3 min: scrunch in a little cream, then finger-style.
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · Straight or wavy hair · Thin hair OK

faq.q: What is an S-curl perm?
faq.a: A perm that gives soft, flowing S-shaped waves through the top of the hair.

faq.q: Is it the same as a wavy perm?
faq.a: Close. An S-curl is a controlled, soft wave. A wavy perm can be looser or tighter.

faq.q: How long should my hair be?
faq.a: About 8–10 cm on top, so the waves have room to show.

faq.q: How do I keep the waves?
faq.a: Use a little cream, do not brush when dry, and condition weekly.

barberSteps: Sides: machine #3, taper to #2 at the neck.
Wrap the top on rods in alternating directions to make S waves.
Cut a light fringe, pushed slightly off the forehead.

name: Garma Perm
shortLine: A centre-parted perm with soft waves that fall to both sides.
description: A popular Korean perm. The hair is parted in the centre or slightly off-centre, and soft waves fall to each side. "Garma" means "part" in Korean.
pickIf: you want the classic, soft Korean centre-part look.
skipIf: you have a very round face, or your hair is very short on top.
daily: 4 min: part the hair, blow dry it sideways, then light wax.
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · Straight or wavy hair · Thin hair OK

faq.q: What does Garma mean?
faq.a: "Garma" is the Korean word for a hair part. A Garma perm is a perm styled around the part.

faq.q: Where should the part be?
faq.a: In the centre or slightly off-centre, where the hair falls most naturally.

faq.q: Is it the same as a middle part cut?
faq.a: Not quite. A Garma perm adds soft waves, so the hair falls in curves instead of straight.

faq.q: How long does it last?
faq.a: About 3–5 months.

barberSteps: Sides: machine #3, taper to #2 at the neck.
Mark the part, then wrap the top on rods for soft waves.
Blow dry the hair sideways from the part.

name: Shaolin Cut
shortLine: A close monk-style shave, kept at a soft shadow.
description: A close shave inspired by the shaved heads of Shaolin monks. The whole head is cut to about 1 mm for an even, soft shadow: cleaner than a buzz cut and easier to keep than a razor shave.

skipIf: you have a sensitive scalp, or you want any hair length.

faq.q: What is a Shaolin cut?
faq.a: A close shave inspired by Shaolin monks: the whole head cut to about 1 mm for an even, soft shadow.

faq.q: How is it different from a head shave?
faq.a: A head shave is razor-smooth. A Shaolin cut keeps a 1 mm shadow, so it needs no razor and has less risk of cuts.

faq.q: How often do I need to cut it?
faq.a: Every 4–5 days with a clipper at #0, or the shadow turns into stubble.

faq.q: Do I need sun cream?
faq.a: Yes, outdoors. A near-bare scalp burns easily.

name: Brahmin Cut
shortLine: A shaved head with a small tuft (shikha) at the crown.
description: A traditional Hindu style: the head is shaved clean, leaving one small tuft of hair at the back of the crown. The tuft is called the shikha, or choti, and is kept as part of religious practice and for rituals.

callouts.title: Small tuft
callouts.text: At the back of the crown.

faq.q: What is a shikha?
faq.a: A small tuft of hair kept at the back of the crown in the Hindu tradition. It is also called a choti or tupi.

faq.q: Who wears it?
faq.a: It is worn as part of religious practice and kept for rituals and ceremonies. If you are unsure, ask your family or priest.

faq.q: How big should the tuft be?
faq.a: The size differs by family and tradition. Ask first. Many keep a tuft about 5 cm across.

faq.q: How do I keep it clean?
faq.a: Wash and comb the tuft daily, and shave around it every 2–3 days.

barberSteps: Ask: how big should the tuft be?
Mark the tuft at the back of the crown with a comb.
Tie or clip the tuft out of the way.
Whole head: machine #0 first, then shaving cream.
Shave smooth with a new blade, with the hair growth.
Trim the tuft to one length and comb it.
